title: Register vector
statement: A register state consists of 17 natural-number registers, and its register vector lists, in order, the input length, halving count, add-twice counter, window radius, code-bound exponent, code bound, doubling scratch register, stage, stage plus one, known-ball size, outer vertex, next-ball count, inner vertex, inner count, guessed code, current walk code, and walk step count.
